zh-CN.title: 桌面聊天迎来阔幅书写台
items: 桌面聊天输入区升级为分层书写台，工具、正文与发送操作更加清晰
表情、附件、位置、足迹、语音、回复和成员提及均可从新书写台直接使用

en.title: A wide writing desk for desktop chat
items: Desktop chat now separates tools, writing, and sending into a spacious composer
Emoji, attachments, location, footprints, voice, replies, and mentions remain directly available
